items.detail: Both V2 overview filenames referenced by the workbook/readme are absent under those exact names.
HOME and CAPTURE are only overview cells; no independent full-screen frozen source.
A static ORB_RETURN state exists; continuous Fish/Gold-to-Orb direction is not shown directly.
Only save control/highlight is shown; no save action or persisted-success feedback frame.
KF12.2 is absent from the 26KF rows; only Frame 5 on the six-frame board supports the intermediate state.
Composite board crops do not provide independent component contours, runtime Mask/P*, Resident paths or Task Energy paths; further source-native measurement is needed.
